label: Mansion
note: Eight rooms of the mansion's own plus two service rooms ("service_room": true) that are the inn's Kitchen and Cellar programs with noble walls and three extra objects: keep or drop those two in the tray as you see fit. Every room is wealth 'fine' (solver.js chooseSku then prefers skus whose tier is 'fine'); 'prefer_skus' lists the mansion's own skus for the room, to pin if tier alone lets an inn sku through.

noble-panel.look: dark oak wainscot to 6 ft in two tiers of panels under a plate rail, cream plaster and cornice above

noble-paper.look: sage-green damask wallpaper over a 3-ft cream panelled dado with a chair rail, cream cornice

conservatory.look: a 2-ft brick plinth carrying cream glazing bars and frosted panes; no window piece (the wall is the window): look.js already falls back to wall-straight when a family has no window

noble-interior.status: exists (walls-01: wall-straight, wall-window-small + open twin); this batch adds its missing doorway
noble-interior.look: cream plaster over a low honey wainscot with a plain dado rail: suits the service wing, back stairs and corridors, too plain for the state rooms

wall_kit.window_role: the tall mansion window is a sku of the engine's window role wall-window-small (look.js places that id by family), NOT of wall-window-large

doors.door-panelled: new role, sku door-panelled--leaf (36x84, leaf only): every single-cell inner door of the mansion
doors.door-double-grand: existing role; the existing door-double-grand--leaf is carved oak with iron studs and ring pulls (castle and inn). New sku door-double-grand--fine-leaf (panelled walnut, brass knobs) for the front door and the ballroom
doors.door-glazed: new role, sku door-glazed--leaf: conservatory and garden doors
doors.fallback: door-plank and door-reinforced never appear in mansion rooms except the cellar (door-reinforced) and the kitchen's yard door (door-plank)

hung_note: add the hung ROLES to solver.js HUNG_IDS: mirror-pier-gilt is 78 in tall and sconce-candle-triple--fine is 9 in deep, so isHung()'s size test (depth <= 8, height <= 48) misses them; bell-board-servants passes it. Flats that hang (painting-*, tapestry, curtains-drapes) are in flats.json. fireplace-marble, clock-longcase, hall-stand, fountain-wall and all bookcases are wall-PLACED floor pieces, not hung
lights_note: all generated UNLIT. fire.js fireType() already classifies every one by id: /^fireplace/ -> hearth, /chandelier/ -> chandelier, /candelabra/ -> candelabra, /candle/ -> candle (sconce-candle-triple), /lamp/ -> lantern (lamp-post-iron). solver2 picks 'chandelier-ring' by name for big-room lights: in mansion rooms it should pick chandelier-grand
stairs: not the mansion's: the vertical kit specifies stair-grand--noble-interior (and stair-half / stair-quarter-turn in other families); the hall's recipe names those roles

program.focal_rule: stair-grand (sku stair-grand--noble-interior, 2x2 cells) centred on the wall facing the front door, rising away from the door; it needs the hall to be at least 4 cells deep. When the hall has no upper floor or is too small, table-pedestal-round stands at the exact centre of the room instead, a vase-flowers on it, rug-round-fine under it
program.centre: with a stair: table-pedestal-round halfway between the door and the stair foot (only when at least 10 ft lie between them), else empty; rug-runner from the door to the stair foot
program.walls: one table-console centred on each side wall with mirror-pier-gilt hung above it and a sconce each side; clock-longcase beside the stair or on the door wall; hall-stand on the door wall beside the front door (1); bench-upholstered (the cream-and-gilt s1) one per 10 ft of leftover side wall; statue-bust or urn-decorative in pairs flanking the stair foot or an inner door; armor-stand (castle batch) 0-2 in the far corners
program.corners: palm-potted or planter-topiary in the two corners of the door wall
program.sits_on: vase-flowers on table-pedestal-round and on each table-console; urn-decorative (porcelain) or statue-bust may stand on pedestal-display--marble
program.hung: mirror-pier-gilt (mount 36 in, above each console); painting-landscape / painting-still-life / painting-portrait at 54 in on the wall between the consoles and the doors (2-6); trophy-head 0-1; sconce-candle-triple either side of each mirror
program.doors: front door = door-double-grand (sku door-double-grand--fine-leaf) in a 2-cell opening; inner doors = door-panelled in wall-doorway--noble-panel

program.why: it is a yard (ROOMS.md -> Outdoors: no walls of its own, ground for a floor, an edge kit on the grid line, a gate where the path leaves), but its style is not a roll: the layout is mirror-symmetric about the path axis and the edge is always a hedge or the stone balustrade

Never fences or dry-stone walls
program.axis: the main axis runs from the house door (or the gate) straight across the garden; a cross axis at the centre. Both are 5-ft walks of floor-gravel laid as ground strips (or decal-path-worn until gravel strips exist). Everything is placed in mirrored pairs about the main axis
program.focal_rule: fountain-courtyard at the crossing of the two walks (the exact centre). gazebo at the far end of the main axis from the house, only in gardens of 42 cells or more (it is 11 ft across: 3x3 cells).
